description_en: Queries the throttling policies bound to all members of an API group in a specified environment
description_zh: 查询指定分组指定环境下所有API的流控策略绑定概况
name: DescribeApiTrafficControls

parameters.help_en:
The runtime environment of the API. Valid values:

RELEASE

TEST: the test environment
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的环境。

RELEASE：线上
TEST：测试
parameters.name: stage_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API group that you want to query
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of APIs that you want to query. Separate multiple API IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 API IDs can be entered
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的API编号，支持输入多个，“,”分隔，最多支持100个
parameters.name: api_ids

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的页码，默认是1，起始是1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时每页行数，最大值100，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size
